instruction: Please help disable the 'Show brush outline' option in GIMP.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the brush outline display option via Edit > Preferences > Image Windows > Appearance. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for (show-brush-outline no) using the existing check_config_status metric. Similar difficulty to the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Postconfig correctly closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure config changes are persisted to disk, which is necessary for GIMP preferences to be written to the gimprc file
Getter (get_gimp_config_file) correctly extracts the gimprc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc on Linux, which is the correct location for GIMP configuration

Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses GIMP config format and checks for the key 'show-brush-outline' with value 'no', which semantically verifies that the brush outline option has been disabled
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric function correctly accesses rule['key'] and rule['value'] without incorrectly trying to access rule.get('rules') or expected.get('type')
Expected value ('show-brush-outline': 'no') is semantically correct for disabling the brush outline in GIMP's config format
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly the requirement stated in the instruction (disable show brush outline)
Runtime feasibility: all components can execute correctly - getter can access the file after GIMP closes, metric can parse the config format
